description: This file contains helper functions for accessing and retrieving items from a list of 'c_item_t' structures, based on keys or string keys, including functions to get data, strings, and parameters associated with items.

methods.name: _c_get_item_by_key
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the list by integer key.

methods.name: _c_get_item_by_strkey
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the list by string key.

methods.name: _c_get_item_by_str
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the list by string data.

methods.name: _c_get_data_by_key
methods.description: Gets the data associated with an item identified by key.

methods.name: _c_get_str_by_key
methods.description: Gets the string data associated with an item by key.

methods.name: _c_get_str_by_strkey
methods.description: Gets the string data associated with an item by string key.

methods.name: _c_get_strkey_by_str
methods.description: Gets the key string of an item by string data.

methods.name: _c_get_value_by_key
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with an item by key.

methods.name: _c_get_param_by_key
methods.description: Retrieves the param associated with an item by key.
